chunks: Abu Basir narrated from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام that he said:
If you release a hawk, a falcon, or an eagle and it kills, then do not eat it until you properly slaughter it.

key_terms.أَرْسَلْتَ: you dispatched or released for hunting
key_terms.تُذَكِّيَهُ: you perform proper ritual slaughter on it
key_terms.عُقَابًا: an eagle or large bird of prey

ai.seo_question: Can hunted game killed by a hawk, falcon, or eagle be eaten without proper slaughter?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning hunting with birds of prey. It states that if such a bird kills the game, the animal is not to be eaten unless it is properly slaughtered afterward according to the prescribed method.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4143 - Abu Basir narrated from Abu Abdillah (as) that Imam (as) said:
"If you release a hawk, a falcon, or an eagle and it kills, do not eat it until you properly slaughter it."
